title: Environment-Fidelity Load Replayer for Private Deployments
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build a deterministic, environment-fidelity load replayer for Private/VPC/on-prem deployments that can reproduce customer traffic shapes and measure tokens/sec and p95 latency across realistic KV cache behavior and startup cold paths. This harness must: 1) ingest captured traces or synthetic scenario definitions, 2) emulate customer sequence-length and concurrency distributions, 3) reproduce environment-level characteristics (network latency, node heterogeneity, quantization variants), 4) emit metrics compatible with our observability stack (per-run tokens/sec, p95, p99, error rates, cost estimation), and 5) produce regression signals against a baseline run with automated alerts. The final deliverable includes an operator-run CLI, a CI integration for nightly regression runs, and a runbook for engineering and SRE teams.
acceptance_criteria: Harness can replay a captured trace and produce deterministic per-request latency distributions with <=5% variance across repeated runs when environment inputs are unchanged
Metrics exported to metrics.redwood.internal and a Grafana dashboard shows per-run tokens/sec, p50/p95/p99, and tail error breakdowns
Regression detection: nightly jobs compare latest run to baseline and open ENG tickets for >=10% regression in p95 or >=15% drop in tokens/sec
Support toggles for simulating network egress delay, node-level heterogeneity, and quantization variant (int8/ptq/awq) configurations
CI job (private-benchmarking/nightly-replay) completes in <4h for large customer traces and archives artifacts to s3://redwood-benchmarks/private-runs/<run-id>
comments: 2026-02-22 - Initial spike: validated trace ingestion format based on existing traffic capture schema. Chose protobuf for compactness over JSONL after discussing storage costs.

2026-02-27 - Design review with Runtime team: agreed to reuse parts of deterministic-traffic-replay library but add environment emulation layer for network/node variability. Runtime suggested kernel warmup phase to avoid cold-start noise.

2026-03-03 - Engineering sync: implementing replay scheduler + concurrency controller. Decision: simulate KV cache hit ratios by replaying same prefix sequences rather than instrumenting model internals to keep harness non-invasive.
2026-03-08 - Security/SRE check: need to ensure traces are redacted and PII removed before storage. Added anonymization step and KMS envelope encryption for S3 artifacts.
2026-03-11 - Review feedback from PM (Priya Nair): add cost-estimation output to help product team quantify unit-economics impact of regressions. Adding token-cost model pulled from billing API.
